title: Acceptance probability under binary encoding
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $r$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a nonadaptive function tester from $\Omega$ to the sign group $\{\pm1\}$ with $r$ transcript positions, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb F_2$. The acceptance probability of the tester obtained by converting $T$'s answers from signs to bits on input $f$ equals the acceptance probability of $T$ on the sign-valued function obtained by encoding each value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive function tester from $\Omega$ to the sign group with $r$ query positions
